lastResponse.text: Thank you for telling me. I’m really glad you spoke up. Heavier bleeding three weeks postpartum can be urgent, so I want you to get medical care now. If you’re soaking a pad in an hour, passing large clots, feeling dizzy, faint, or weak, call nine one one right now. If not, please go to the nearest ER or call your OB or hospital triage immediately. I can stay with you while we get you connected.
originalTexts: Thank you for telling me. I’m really glad you spoke up. Heavier bleeding three weeks postpartum can be urgent, so I want you to get medical care now. If you’re soaking a pad in an hour, passing large clots, feeling dizzy, faint, or weak, call 911 right now. If not, please go to the nearest ER or call your OB or hospital triage immediately. I can stay with you while we get you connected.
